text:
HYMNOI KΘ'

2

mētēr eribremetou, polumorphou Eubouleōs, sumpaikteira Hōrōn, Phōsphore, aglaomorphē, semnē, pantokratōr, koura polukarpe, phaesphore, kerouche, monē pothēta thnētois, earinē, leimōnopnoois chairousa, phainousa hieron eidos en chlōrokarpois thallesin, en phthinopōrinē harpagē gamou lechous zeugnumenē, zōē kai thanatos monē polumochthois thnētois, Persephoneia, panta gar aeiphereis te kai phthineis. klūthi, makaira thea, kai karpous anapempe apo gēs.

Klementos de ho Alexandreus, Arnobios, kai heteroi tas geneseis exēgēsanto.

KΘ'. (ΚΗ'.) 8. Eikos ton Eubouleā touton Bakkchon einai.

KΘ'. (ΚΗ'.) 9. Ta pleista tōn hexēs eis touto teinei, hoti hē tēs Proserpinēs en tois katachthoniois kai tois anō oikēsis enallax, sumbolon esti tōn spermatōn kruptomenōn kai epeita ekphainomenōn.

KΘ'. (ΚΗ'.) 9. Chalepon isōs eipein tis hē tōn Hōrōn sumplokos eiē. oude gar hē sunōriphos, hēn Skaligeros hērmēneusen, areskei moi. hai Hōrai, parthenoi oūsai tēs anthousēs hēlikias, eisin hai sun hais tēn Proserpinan paizein prepōn esti. dio hē tou lamproū Heringa eikasia megalōs me euphrainei.

KΘ'. 9. Hora ton Humnon XLIII. 7.

KΘ'. (ΚΗ'.) 12. Peri tēs tēs prōtēs sullabēs brachunseōs en tois pnoiesi, kai tōn homoiōn, en tois Argonautikois 163 dielechthē.

KΘ'. (ΚΗ'.) 13. Ho lampros Lennep en tais sēmeiōsesin epi ton Koloūthon sel. 132 hupopteuei ton Skaligeron anagnōnai ton stichon hōs: phainousan hieron eidos.

KΘ'. 13. To chlōrokarpon kai hupo tou Lennep epi tou Koloūthou sel. 132 kai tou Dinnerou hupo tēn lexin Persephonē chrētai. hoi stichoi 12, 13, kai 14 ek tou Homērikou Humnou eis Dēmētran 445 phōtistheien an: "kai tē thugatēr, peritellomenou tou eniautou, to triton meros hupo ton zophon ēeronta, duo de merē sun tē mētri kai tois allois athanatois..." entautha dēlon hoti stichos tis exepesen apo tou 471, hos sunēchthē apo tou 465. hoi gar stichoi 466-470 hupo tinōn hamartē epanelephthēsan.
